$note: Light standard v2 (ADR-0021, docs/design/light-standard.md): value targets measured from the founder-picked references (I1's seasons for day, golden, rain and snow; the gezgin f2 night and Revontuli stuck for night), per colour-script cell x layer, measured by tools/imagegen/light.py on the subject region at 800 px; the frame block applies to opaque takes (sky above, cloud sea below). The references live in a high-key envelope (L* p5 50-64, p50 74-90, p98 90-97); night is a hue change, not a value drop (only the sky goes dark); the cloud sea is a bright reflector. v1's 'true darks, never lifted blacks' rules (p2 <= 22, haze <= 0.20) failed every liked reference and are gone. Key direction, rim, fill, shadow hue and fog are NOT stored here: they are read from design/art/colour-script.json. enforce: false keeps a failing check a warning for production jobs.

metrics.p5: 5th percentile of L on the subject region: the floor of the darks (eyes and the darkest recesses, under 5 % of a sprite, are allowed below it)
metrics.median: L p50 band [lo, hi] on the subject region
metrics.p98: 98th percentile of L on the subject region: the lights reach cream
metrics.lc_p75: band [min, max] of the p75 local standard deviation of L/100 in a 9x9 window, x100: one soft texture scale (the 'too contrasty' Tam Cicek night is 6.6, the liked nights 2.4-3.9)
metrics.frame.sky_L: opaque takes: mean L of the top eighth (the sky), band [lo, hi]
metrics.frame.sea_L_min: opaque takes: mean L of the bottom eighth (the cloud sea, the world's reflector), at least
metrics.frame.dark_max: opaque takes: % of pixels below L* 30 under the top quarter (only the sky may be dark), at most

reference.$note: Measured 2026-11-07 with tools/imagegen/light.py (subject p5 / p50 / p98 / lc; frame sky / sea / dark %). Each must pass its cell; tools/imagegen/tests/test_light.py checks it.

layers.subject: the plane the player reads (the character, the station, the home island): the clearest forms, still inside the envelope
layers.near: close but not the focus: the same envelope, a touch of air
layers.far: receding: lighter and flatter, drifting toward the fog colour from colour-script

contact_shadow.plate: painted soft and short, directly under the object, in the cell's shadow hue (an occlusion pad, never a black cast shadow)
